 GTA VI fever grips India as demand for consoles, gaming cafe bookings surge
 Similarly, physical electronics retailers said the demand for gaming consoles has picked up ahead of GTA VI’s release
 By Rohan Das 
 Updated - November 18, 2026 at 09:09 PM. 
 | 
 Chennai
 × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/variety/gta-vi-fever-grips-india-as-demand-for-consoles-gaming-cafe-bookings-surge/article71716698.ece Copy 
 Meanwhile, data from digital intelligence platform Sensor Tower suggests that globally, GTA VI pre-orders globally have surged to 11.3 million, which can amount to an estimated $1.1 billion in pre-order revenue.
 | Photo Credit:
 EVA MARIE UZCATEGUI
 After over a decade of anticipation, GTA VI, the latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series, one of the best-selling video game franchises of all time, launches on Wednesday midnight, has had Indian gamers counting down the seconds.
 Pre-orders for the game soared across platforms while game consoles such as PS5 and Xbox have been flying off shelves with electronics retailers and e-commerce platforms reporting a marked increase in demand for these devices.
 Zeba Khan, Director - Consumer Electronics, Amazon India said that Grand Theft Auto VI is now the most pre-ordered video game in Amazon India’s history. Khan added that customer visits to the games product pages have risen nearly 60 per cent compared with an average week. While controller sales have increased more than 50 per cent and streaming accessories have risen 2X.
 “The excitement around this launch is unlike anything we have seen before,” she said. The game, though controversially not available as physical discs, can be ordered a “Code in Box” edition that contains a digital download code rather than physical discs.
 Similarly, physical electronics retailers said the demand for gaming consoles has picked up ahead of GTA VI’s release.
 “We have seen that momentum build as the launch draws closer. The increase in demand we’ve seen has been largely centred on the PS5. We’re also seeing growing interest in the wider PlayStation ecosystem,” Shibashish Roy, CEO & MD, Infiniti Retail (Croma) said.
 Local gaming cafes are also stepping up to cater to the demand.
 Bengaluru-based Gaming Galaxy is expecting a surge in footfall on Thursday following the launch. “We have six consoles in our cafe that can be booked for 1 hour slots. For Thursday, they have been booked for almost the entire day. We are planning on expanding operating hours,” owner Utkarsh Jain said.
 Meanwhile, data from digital intelligence platform Sensor Tower suggests that globally, GTA VI pre-orders globally have surged to 11.3 million, which can amount to an estimated $1.1 billion in pre-order revenue.
 Developed by American studio Rockstar Games, GTA VI has over the years evolved into a cultural phenomenon, with the long anticipation and repeated delays spawning the internet meme “before GTA VI”.
 Vishal Parekh, Chief Operating Officer, CyberPowerPC India said that given the anticipation surrounding GTA VI, it has the potential to become an entry point into the gaming ecosystem for an entirely new generation of Indian gamers while also opening up opportunities for content creators.
 Interestingly, Inde a Chennai-based Interior design firm has declared a company-wide holiday on Thursday for its employees, according to an Instagram post by founder Kishore Shanmugam.
